mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (task_code, task_goal, task_family, scene_params, goal_parsing_result, status, current_plan_version_id, replan_used, replanning_reason, manual_terminate_reason, failure_reason, missing_info_questions, downgrade_reason, is_dry_run, created_at, updated_at, created_by) VALUES (#{taskCode}, #{taskGoal}, #{taskFamily}, #{sceneParams}::json, #{goalParsingResult}::json, #{status}, #{currentPlanVersionId}, #{replanUsed}, #{replanningReason}, #{manualTerminateReason}, #{failureReason}, #{missingInfoQuestions}::json, #{downgradeReason}, #{isDryRun}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET task_goal = #{taskGoal}, task_family = #{taskFamily}, scene_params = #{sceneParams}::json, goal_parsing_result = #{goalParsingResult}::json, status = #{status}, current_plan_version_id = #{currentPlanVersionId}, replan_used = #{replanUsed}, replanning_reason = #{replanningReason}, manual_terminate_reason = #{manualTerminateReason}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, missing_info_questions = #{missingInfoQuestions}::json, downgrade_reason = #{downgradeReason}, is_dry_run = #{isDryRun}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE tasks SET replan_used = TRUE, replanning_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND replan_used = FALSE
